patterns.title: No Front Door
patterns.summary: The repository has no useful README/project landing surface, so the product can only be inferred by reading source.
evidence_signals: README absent or opening does not state purpose/value.
patterns.remediation: Create a concise opening: what it is, who it is for, outcome, proof, and next step.

patterns.title: Implementation-first positioning
patterns.summary: The opening leads with stack/architecture before giving visitors a reason to care.
evidence_signals: README starts with framework/language internals and delays product value.
patterns.remediation: Lead with user outcome and differentiator; move internals below proof and quick start.

patterns.title: Value proposition hidden in the app
patterns.summary: The product explains itself only after installation or runtime.
evidence_signals: Strong product copy exists in application templates but not at the repo Front Door.
patterns.remediation: Promote the strongest truthful value proposition to the README opening.

patterns.title: Target user is implicit
patterns.summary: Visitors must guess who the project is for.
evidence_signals: No audience/use-case statement at Front Door.
patterns.remediation: Name the primary user/use case in one sentence.

patterns.title: No reason to choose it
patterns.summary: The repo says what it is but not why this project deserves attention.
evidence_signals: Feature list lacks a distinctive mechanism/outcome.
patterns.remediation: State the strongest evidence-backed differentiator near the top.

patterns.title: No product proof
patterns.summary: The repository asks visitors to imagine the result.
evidence_signals: No screenshot, GIF, captured output, executable example, or equivalent.
patterns.remediation: Add one real proof artifact showing the strongest workflow.

patterns.title: Proof is buried
patterns.summary: A demo exists but is difficult to find.
evidence_signals: Proof is several sections deep or hidden behind unclear navigation.
patterns.remediation: Move one representative proof above the fold or link it prominently.

patterns.title: Demo is not grounded
patterns.summary: Visuals imply behavior that is not connected to accessible project output.
evidence_signals: Only conceptual mockups or marketing art are shown.
patterns.remediation: Use a real screenshot/output or label mockups explicitly.

patterns.title: Primary demo path is broken
patterns.summary: The strongest advertised flow fails in available evidence.
evidence_signals: Broken assets/routes/example command in the main demonstration.
patterns.remediation: Repair the demo path before launch and rerun Proof Mode.

patterns.title: Manifest exists but is empty/broken
patterns.summary: A conventional dependency/setup file exists but cannot reproduce setup.
evidence_signals: 0-byte or malformed manifest.
patterns.remediation: Populate/fix the manifest and verify install in a clean environment.

patterns.title: No reproducible installation path
patterns.summary: Visitors cannot convert the repo into a runnable project.
evidence_signals: No concrete setup command/procedure at Front Door.
patterns.remediation: Document exact setup and align it with manifests.

patterns.title: Too many steps to first value
patterns.summary: A visitor must complete a long ceremony before seeing a meaningful result.
evidence_signals: More than three essential post-prerequisite actions.
patterns.remediation: Provide a minimal quick start and move advanced setup later.

patterns.title: Local environment shipped as setup
patterns.summary: A local environment is distributed instead of reproducible dependencies.
evidence_signals: Committed .venv/node_modules/build output or platform-specific binaries.
patterns.remediation: Remove environment artifacts; document runtime version and dependency install.

patterns.title: Critical configuration is implicit
patterns.summary: The app requires configuration that is only discoverable in code/errors.
evidence_signals: Environment variables/ports/files required but undocumented.
patterns.remediation: Document required configuration and safe examples.

patterns.title: Limitations are hidden
patterns.summary: Docs present the happy path without material stage limitations.
evidence_signals: Known incomplete workflows are not disclosed.
patterns.remediation: State important current limitations near the relevant feature.

patterns.title: No explicit license
patterns.summary: Potential users cannot confidently reuse or contribute.
evidence_signals: No license file/trusted package license metadata.
patterns.remediation: Add an explicit license appropriate for the project.

patterns.title: No verification signal
patterns.summary: Visitors cannot see evidence that important behavior is checked.
evidence_signals: No tests, validation, reproducible examples, or proof artifacts.
patterns.remediation: Add meaningful tests/validation or a reproducible verified example.

patterns.title: No maintenance signal
patterns.summary: The repo gives no indication of how changes/releases are checked.
evidence_signals: No CI, releases, changelog, or equivalent.
patterns.remediation: Add a small CI workflow and/or transparent release notes.

patterns.title: Public claim exceeds implementation
patterns.summary: The Front Door promises more than accessible evidence supports.
evidence_signals: Claim Verification returns CONTRADICTED.
patterns.remediation: Narrow the claim or finish the workflow, then prove it.

patterns.title: Unverifiable performance claim
patterns.summary: Performance language appears without reproducible methodology.
evidence_signals: Performance numbers without benchmark details.
patterns.remediation: Publish method/data or remove/narrow the claim.

patterns.title: Compatibility overclaim
patterns.summary: A single environment pass is generalized to all platforms/configurations.
evidence_signals: Docs claim broad support beyond tested execution scope.
patterns.remediation: State exact tested scope and separate it from intended support.

patterns.title: Secret or credential material shipped
patterns.summary: Shareable artifacts or source contain a credential-like value.
evidence_signals: Plaintext password/token/key or real credential-looking seed data.
patterns.remediation: Redact reports, remove/rotate exposed material, and move secrets to environment/config.

patterns.title: Personal data shipped as fixture
patterns.summary: Seed/example data contains real-looking personal information.
evidence_signals: Names/emails/photos appear in distributed fixtures without clear fictionalization.
patterns.remediation: Replace with obviously fictional fixtures and redact reports.

patterns.title: Generated/local noise shipped
patterns.summary: The distributed repo is dominated by machine-local artifacts.
evidence_signals: venv/node_modules/cache/build/editor debris at root.
patterns.remediation: Add ignore rules and distribute only source/reproducible outputs.

patterns.title: Broken Front Door reference
patterns.summary: README points at missing assets/files/anchors.
evidence_signals: Local README link/image does not resolve.
patterns.remediation: Fix or remove the reference; validate Front Door refs in CI.

patterns.title: Primary file is a placeholder
patterns.summary: A conventional key file exists but contains nothing useful.
evidence_signals: Empty README/manifest/config/style on the primary path.
patterns.remediation: Populate it or remove it if it is not part of the product.

patterns.title: Identity naming drifts
patterns.summary: README/package/app use materially different names.
evidence_signals: Two independent naming surfaces conflict.
patterns.remediation: Choose a canonical project name and align metadata.

patterns.title: Score without criterion evidence
patterns.summary: A numeric launch score is presented without auditable criterion states.
evidence_signals: Points cannot be traced to PASS/FAIL evidence.
patterns.remediation: Use the deterministic rubric and persist criterion-level evidence.

patterns.title: N/A treated as success
patterns.summary: A missing prerequisite accidentally earns points.
evidence_signals: Criterion passes vacuously because there was nothing to inspect.
patterns.remediation: Use N_A with zero points; never treat absence as success.

patterns.title: Proof scope is overgeneralized
patterns.summary: A sandbox/local test is reported as universal compatibility.
evidence_signals: Runtime result is phrased beyond environment actually exercised.
patterns.remediation: Record environment and limitations with every Proof Mode run.

patterns.title: Launch audit drifts into generic code review
patterns.summary: The report fills with refactors that do not affect launch trust/reproducibility/truthfulness.
evidence_signals: Findings lack connection to launch readiness.
patterns.remediation: Keep only issues that materially change launch readiness or primary proof.

patterns.title: Everything becomes a blocker
patterns.summary: The report dilutes priority by labeling many minor issues as launch blockers.
evidence_signals: Large blocker list with low-impact items.
patterns.remediation: Reserve blockers for issues that materially stop trust, trial, truthfulness, or core demonstration.
